name: update_connection
description: Fully replace mutable fields of an existing connection. Provide every field; expires_at null clears expiry. From endpoint is not changed. Repeating the same update is safe. Do not invent connection IDs — look them up with find_connections first.

id.description: ID of the connection to update.

to_id.description: Destination location ID. May equal from_id for a self-loop. Must already exist.

bidirectional.description: When true, the recorded transition may be used in reverse as well.

description.description: Complete narrative description of the transition.

expires_at.description: Unix timestamp when the transition ceases to be valid, or null for no expiry.
